summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes large obfuscated payload from a CSS theme package
details: @servicetitan/kendo-theme@0.0.27 is published as a Kendo CSS theme (main:./dist/index.css) but declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that fetches the Bun runtime from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13), extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute the tarball-shipped `math_init.js` — a 727 KB obfuscated Bun-cjs blob using classic string-array-with-rotation obfuscation (top-level array `n7gIxM`, rotator `WV8StW`, `_0x...`-renamed identifiers). If `bun` is already on PATH the download is skipped and the payload is executed directly. A CSS/SCSS theme has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or a large obfuscated JS bundle at install time; the alternate-runtime path also bypasses Node-based scanners and lifecycle sandboxes. The scope `@servicetitan` matches a known SaaS vendor, consistent with namespace impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
